verses.geez: ራእይ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ወልደ፡ አሞጽ፡ በእንተ፡ ባቢሎን።
verses.translation: The Vision which Esaias son of Amos saw against Babylon.

translations.lxx: The Vision which Esaias son of Amos saw against Babylon.
translations.kjv: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
translations.ron: Proorocia despre Babilon pe care a văzut-o Isaia, fiul lui Amos.
translations.grk: ὍΡΑΣΙΣ ἫΝ ΕΙΔΕΝ ἩΣΑΙΑΣ ΥΙΟΣ ἈΜΩΣ ΚΑΤΑ ΒΑΒΥΛΩΝΟΣ.

verses.geez: ንሥኡ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባረ፡ ገዳም፤ አንሥኡ፡ ቃለክሙ፡ ወአጽንዑ፡ እደዊክሙ፣፡ ያርኅዉ፡ መላእክት።
verses.translation: Lift up a standard on the mountain of the plain, exalt the voice to them, beckon with the hand, open the gates, ye rulers.

translations.lxx: Lift up a standard on the mountain of the plain, exalt the voice to them, beckon with the hand, open the gates, ye rulers.
translations.kjv: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
translations.ron: Pe un munte pleşuv înălţaţi steag, strigaţi către ei, faceţi semn cu mâna, ca să intre pe poarta asupritorilor.
translations.grk: Ἐπʼ ὄρους πεδινοῦ ἄρατε σημεῖον, ὑψώσατε τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῖς, παρακαλεῖτε τῇ χειρί, ἀνοίξατε οἱ ἄρχοντες.

verses.geez: አነ፡ እኤዝዞሙ፡ ወአነ፡ አመጽኦሙ፡ ለቅዱሳንየ፤ አነ፡ አመጽኦሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ያርብሕ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ወይፌጽሙ፡ መዐትየ፡ ወያኀሥርዎሙ።
verses.translation: I give command, and I bring them: giants are coming to fulfil my wrath, rejoicing at the same time and insulting.

translations.lxx: I give command, and I bring them: giants are coming to fulfil my wrath, rejoicing at the same time and insulting.
translations.kjv: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
translations.ron: "Eu am poruncit sfintei Mele oştiri, zice Domnul, chemat-am pe vitejii mâniei Mele, pe cei ce se veselesc de slava Mea".
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ συντάσσω, καὶ ἐγώ αὐτούς· γίγαντες ἔρχονται πληρῶσαι τὸν θυμόν μου χαίροντες ἅμα καὶ ὑβρίζοντες.

verses.geez: ውውዓ፡ ብዙኃን፡ አሕዛብ፡ ላዕለ፡ አድባር፡ ከመ፡ ዘብዙኃን፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወሠራዊት፡ ወነገሥት፡ እለ፡ ተጋብኡ፤ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ አዘዘ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ መስተቃትላን፡ ይምጽኡ።
verses.translation: A voice of many nations on the mountains, even like to that of many nations; a voice of kings and nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts has given command to a war-like nation,

translations.lxx: A voice of many nations on the mountains, even like to that of many nations; a voice of kings and nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts has given command to a war-like nation,
translations.kjv: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi acest zgomot surd în munţi, vuiet al unui neam fără de număr; auziţi această zarvă de împărăţii, de neamuri adunate; Domnul Savaot cercetează oştirea gata de luptă.
translations.grk: Φωνὴ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων, ὁμοία ἐθνῶν πολλῶν, φωνὴ βασιλέων καὶ ἐθνῶν συνηγμένων· Κύριος σαβαὼθ ἐντέταλται ἔθνει ὁπλομάχῳ,

verses.geez: እምርኁቅ፡ ብሔር፡ እምአጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ መሠረተ፡ ሰማይ፤ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወመስተቃትላኒሁ፡ ያጠፍእዋ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: to come from a land afar off, from the utmost foundation of heaven; the Lord and his warriors are coming to destroy all the world.

translations.lxx: to come from a land afar off, from the utmost foundation of heaven; the Lord and his warriors are coming to destroy all the world.
translations.kjv: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
translations.ron: Ele vin dintr-un ţinut depărtat, de la capătul cerului; vine Domnul şi uneltele mâniei Lui, ca să nimicească tot pământul.
translations.grk: ἔρχεσθαι ἐκ γῆς πόῤῥωθεν ἀπʼ ἄκρου θεμελίου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, Κύριος καὶ οἱ ὁπλομάχοι αὐτοῦ, καταφθεῖραι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην.

verses.geez: ወውዑ፡ እስመ፡ ቀርበት፡ ዕለተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይመጽእ፡ ተቀጥቅጦ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Howl ye, for the day of the Lord is near, and destruction from God shall arrive.

translations.lxx: Howl ye, for the day of the Lord is near, and destruction from God shall arrive.
translations.kjv: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
translations.ron: Strigaţi, că aproape este ziua Domnului, ea vine ca o pustiire de la Cel Atotputernic.
translations.grk: Ὀλολύζετε, ἐγγὺς γὰρ ἡμέρα Κυρίου, καὶ συντριβὴ παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἥξει.

verses.geez: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ እድ፡ ይደክም፡ ወኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይደነግፅ።
verses.translation: Therefore every hand shall become powerless, and every soul of man shall be dismayed.

translations.lxx: Therefore every hand shall become powerless, and every soul of man shall be dismayed.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
translations.ron: Drept aceea, toate braţele vor fi neputincioase şi inima omului se va topi de frică.
translations.grk: Διάτοῦτο πᾶσα χεὶρ ἐκλυθήσεται, καὶ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἀνθρώπου δειλιάσει.

verses.geez: ወይትሀወኩ፡ ሊቃውንት፡ ወይእኅዞሙ፡ ማሕምም፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንት፡ ትወልድ፤ ወይትቃተሉ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፤ ይትቀጽዑ፡ ወይትባረጽ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ከመ፡ እሳት።
verses.translation: The elders shall be troubled, and pangs shall seize them, as of a woman in travail: and they shall mourn one to another, and shall be amazed, and shall change their countenance as a flame.

translations.lxx: The elders shall be troubled, and pangs shall seize them, as of a woman in travail: and they shall mourn one to another, and shall be amazed, and shall change their countenance as a flame.
translations.kjv: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
translations.ron: Vor fi cuprinşi de spaimă, vor vedea năluci şi durerile îi vor cuprinde; zvârcolise-vor în dureri ca femeia gata să nască. Se vor privi unul pe altul cu groază, iar feţele lor vor fi roşii ca flacăra.
translations.grk: Ταραχθήσονται οἱ πρέσβεις, καὶ ὠδῖνες αὐτοὺς ἕξουσιν, ὡς γυναικὸς τικτούσης· καὶ συμφοράσουσιν ἕτερος πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον, καὶ ἐκστήσονται, καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ὡς φλὸξ μεταβαλοῦσιν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ናሁ፡ ትመጽእ፡ ዕለተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እንተ፡ ምልእት፡ መዐተ፡ ወመቅሠፍተ፣፡ ከመ፡ ታጥፍእ፡ ዓለመ፡ ወታኀልቆሙ፡ ለብዙኃን፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እምኔሃ።
verses.translation: For behold! the day of the Lord is coming which cannot be escaped, a day of wrath and anger, to make the world desolate, and to destroy sinners out of it.

translations.lxx: For behold! the day of the Lord is coming which cannot be escaped, a day of wrath and anger, to make the world desolate, and to destroy sinners out of it.
translations.kjv: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
translations.ron: Iată ziua Domnului, ea vine aprigă, mânioasă şi întărâtată la mânie ca să pustiiască pământul şi să stârpească pe păcătoşi de pe el.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἡμέρα Κυρίου ἔρχεται ἀνίατος, θυμοῦ καὶ ὀργῆς, θεῖναι τὴν οἰκουμένην ἔρημον, καὶ τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἀπολέσαι ἐξ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢይበርሁ፡ እንከ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ እለ፡ አርዮብ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዓለመ፡ ሰማይ፤ ወፀሐይኒ፡ ሠሪቆ፡ ይጸልም፡ ወወርኅኒ፡ ኢይበርሀ።
verses.translation: For the stars of heaven, and Orion, and all the host of heaven, shall not give their light; and it shall be dark at sunrise, and the moon shall not give her light.

translations.lxx: For the stars of heaven, and Orion, and all the host of heaven, shall not give their light; and it shall be dark at sunrise, and the moon shall not give her light.
translations.kjv: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
translations.ron: Luceferii de pe cer şi grămezile de stele nu-şi vor mai da lumina lor; soarele se va întuneca în răsăritul lui şi luna nu va mai străluci.
translations.grk: Οἱ γὰρ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὁ Ὠρίων καὶ πᾶς ὁ κόσμος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, τὸ φῶς οὐ δώσουσι· καὶ σκοτισθήσεται τοῦ ἡλίου ἀνατέλλοντος, καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወእኤዝዝ፡ እንከ፡ እኪተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ወላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፤ ወእሥዕር፡ ትዕቢቶሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፣፡ ወበትዝኅርቶሙ፡ ለዕቡያን፡ አኀሥሮሙ።
verses.translation: And I will command evils for the whole world, and will visit their sins on the ungodly: and I will destroy the pride of transgressors, and will bring low the pride of the haughty.

translations.lxx: And I will command evils for the whole world, and will visit their sins on the ungodly: and I will destroy the pride of transgressors, and will bring low the pride of the haughty.
translations.kjv: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
translations.ron: Atunci voi pedepsi lumea pentru fărădelegile ei şi pe cei nelegiuiţi pentru păcatele lor. Voi smeri mândria celor îngâmfaţi şi obrăznicia celor cruzi o voi arunca la pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐντελοῦμαι τῇ οἰκουμένῃ ὅλῃ κακὰ, καὶ τοῖς ἀσεβέσι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν· καὶ ἀπολῶ ὕβριν ἀνόμων, καὶ ὕβριν ὑπερηφάνων ταπεινώσω.

verses.geez: ወእለ፡ ተርፉ፡ ይትበደሩ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ወእምብሩር፤ ወይትበደር፡ ሰብእ፡ እምእንቈ፡ ሰንፔር።
verses.translation: And they that are left shall be more precious than gold tried in the fire; and a man shall be more precious than the stone that is in Suphir.

translations.lxx: And they that are left shall be more precious than gold tried in the fire; and a man shall be more precious than the stone that is in Suphir.
translations.kjv: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
translations.ron: Voi face ca oamenii să fie mai rari decât aurul cel mai scump, mai căutaţi decât aurul de Ofir.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι ἔντιμοι μᾶλλον ἢ τὸ χρυσίον τὸ ἄπυρον· καὶ ἄνθρωπος μᾶλλον ἔντιμος ἔσται ἢ ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐν Σουφείρ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሰማይ፡ ይትመዐዕ፡ ወምድርኒ፡ ያንቀለቅል፡ እመሠረቱ፡ በእንተ፡ መዐተ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ አመ፡ ይመጽእ፡ መዐቱ።
verses.translation: For the heaven shall be enraged, and the earth shall be shaken from her foundation, because of the fierce anger of the Lord of hosts, in the day in which his wrath shall come on.

translations.lxx: For the heaven shall be enraged, and the earth shall be shaken from her foundation, because of the fierce anger of the Lord of hosts, in the day in which his wrath shall come on.
translations.kjv: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta voi prăbuşi cerurile; şi pământul se va clătina din locul lui, din pricina mâniei Domnului Savaot, în ziua iuţimii mâniei Lui.
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ οὐρανὸς θυμωθήσεται, καὶ ἡ γῆ σεισθήσεται ἐκ τῶν θεμελίων αὐτῆς, διὰ θυμὸν ὀργῆς Κυρίου σαβαὼθ, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἂν ἐπέλθῃ ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወይከውኑ፡ እለ፡ ተርፉ፡ ከመ፡ ወይጠል፡ ዘያመሥጥ፡ ወከመ፡ በግዕ፡ ዘተኀጥአ፣፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያገብኦ፡ ዘይመይጦ፤ ይትመየጥ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ይእቱ፡ ብሔሮ።
verses.translation: And they that are left shall be as a fleeing fawn, and as a stray sheep, and there shall be none to gather them: so that a man shall turn back to his people, and a man shall flee to his own land.

translations.lxx: And they that are left shall be as a fleeing fawn, and as a stray sheep, and there shall be none to gather them: so that a man shall turn back to his people, and a man shall flee to his own land.
translations.kjv: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
translations.ron: Atunci, ca o gazelă sperioasă şi ca o turmă pe care nimeni nu poate s-o adune, fiecare se va întoarce la poporul său şi fiecare va fugi în pământul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι ὡς δορκάδιον φεῦγον, καὶ ὡς πρόβατον πλανώμενον, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ συνάγων, ὥστε ἄνθρωπον εἰς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀποστραφῆναι, καὶ ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὴν χώραν ἑαυτοῦ διώξεται.

verses.geez: ወእለሂ፡ ተዘርዉ፡ ይመውቱ፣፡ ወእለሂ፡ ተጋብኡ፡ ይወድቁ፡ በኵናት።
verses.translation: For whosoever shall be taken shall be overcome; and they that are gathered together shall fall by the sword.

translations.lxx: For whosoever shall be taken shall be overcome; and they that are gathered together shall fall by the sword.
translations.kjv: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
translations.ron: Oricine va fi aflat va fi străpuns şi oricare va fi prins va cădea de sabie.
translations.grk: Ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἁλῷ, ἡττηθήσεται, καὶ οἵτινες συνηγμένοι εἰσὶ, πεσοῦνται μαχαίρᾳ.

verses.geez: ወይነፅኁ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ወይበረብሩ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወይስሕቡ፡ አንስቲያሆሙ።
verses.translation: And they shall dash their children before their eyes; and they shall spoil their houses, and shall take their wives.

translations.lxx: And they shall dash their children before their eyes; and they shall spoil their houses, and shall take their wives.
translations.kjv: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
translations.ron: Copiii lor vor fi zdrobiţi înaintea ochilor lor, casele lor vor fi jefuite şi femeile lor necinstite.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ῥάξουσιν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰς οἰκίας αὐτῶν προνομεύσουσιν, καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν ἕξουσιν.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አነሥኦሙ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ለፋርስ፡ እለ፡ ኢይፈቅድዎ፡ ለወርቅ፡ ወኢይሔልይዎ፡ ለብሩር።
verses.translation: Behold, I will stir up against you the Medes, who do not regard silver, neither have they need of gold.

translations.lxx: Behold, I will stir up against you the Medes, who do not regard silver, neither have they need of gold.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
translations.ron: Iată că Eu ridic asupra lor pe Mezi, care nu pun preţ pe argint şi care nu se lăcomesc pentru aur.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἐπεγείρω ὑμῖν τοὺς Μήδους, οἳ ἀργύριον οὐ λογίζονται, οὐδὲ χρυσίου χρείαν ἔχουσι.

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይቀጠቅጡ፡ ወየሐስዩ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ወሬዛ፤ ወኢይምሐሩ፡ ሕፃናቲክሙ፡ ወኢይምሕኩ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ለውሉድክሙ።
verses.translation: They shall break the bows of the young men; and they shall have no mercy on your children; nor shall their eyes spare thy children.

translations.lxx: They shall break the bows of the young men; and they shall have no mercy on your children; nor shall their eyes spare thy children.
translations.kjv: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
translations.ron: Arcurile oamenilor de luptă vor doborî pe cei tineri. De roada pântecelui nu se vor milostivi, şi pentru copii ochii lor nu vor simţi nici o milă.
translations.grk: Τοξεύματα νεανίσκων συντρίψουσι, καὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσωσιν, οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς τέκνοις σου φείσονται οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወትከውን፡ ባቢሎን፡ እንተ፡ ይብልዋ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ፋርስ፡ ክብርተ፡ ከመ፡ ሰዶም፡ ወገሞራ፡ እለ፡ ገፍትዖን፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, shall be as when God overthrew Sodoma and Gomorrha.

translations.lxx: And Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, shall be as when God overthrew Sodoma and Gomorrha.
translations.kjv: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
translations.ron: Atunci Babilonul, podoaba împărăţiilor, cununa mândriei Caldeilor, fi-va ca Sodoma şi ca Gomora, pe care Dumnezeu le-a nimicit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται Βαβυλὼν ἣ καλεῖται ἔνδοξος ἀπὸ βασιλέως Χαλδαίων, ὃν τρόπον κατέστρεψεν ὁ Θεὸς Σόδομα καὶ Γόμοῤῥα·

verses.geez: ኢትሄሉ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወኢትነብር፡ እንከ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፤ ወኢይበውእዋ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ትውልድ፡ ወኢያኀልፍዋ፡ ዐረብ፡ ወኢያዐርፉ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ኖሎት።
verses.translation: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall any enter into it for many generations: neither shall the Arabians pass through it; nor shall shepherds at all rest in it.

translations.lxx: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall any enter into it for many generations: neither shall the Arabians pass through it; nor shall shepherds at all rest in it.
translations.kjv: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
translations.ron: Nu va mai fi locuit în veci şi din neam în neam. Arabii nu vor mai înfige acolo corturi şi nici ciobanii nu-şi vor mai face târle în latura aceea.
translations.grk: Οὐ κατοικηθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον, οὐδὲ μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς αὐτὴν διὰ πολλῶν γενεῶν, οὐδὲ μὴ διέλθωσιν αὐτὴν Ἄραβες, οὐδὲ ποιμένες οὐ μὴ ἀναπαύσονται ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: ወየኀድርዋ፡ አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወይመልእ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲሃ፡ መጽአሞ፤ ወየዐርፉ፡ በውስቴታ፡ ፄደናታት፡ ወይዘፍኑ፡ በህየ፡ አጋንንት።
verses.translation: But wild beasts shall rest there; and the houses shall be filled with howling; and monsters shall rest there, and devils shall dance there,

translations.lxx: But wild beasts shall rest there; and the houses shall be filled with howling; and monsters shall rest there, and devils shall dance there,
translations.kjv: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
translations.ron: Ci numai animale sălbatice se vor sălăşlui într-însul, şi bufniţele vor locui prin case, struţii îşi vor face cuiburi acolo şi oameni cu chip de ţap vor juca în acel loc.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐκεῖ θηρία, καὶ ἐμπλησθήσονται αἱ οἰκίαι ἤχου· καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐκεῖ σειρῆνες, καὶ δαιμόνια ἐκεῖ ὀρχήσονται,

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ፡ ህየ፡ እለ፡ ጽፍረ፡ ላህም፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ ወይትዋለዱ፡ በህየ፡ መራክብት፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: and satyrs shall dwell there; and hedgehogs shall make their nests in their houses. It will come soon, and will not tarry.

translations.lxx: and satyrs shall dwell there; and hedgehogs shall make their nests in their houses. It will come soon, and will not tarry.
translations.kjv: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
translations.ron: Şacalii vor urla în palatele lor şi lupii în casele lor de petrecere. Vremea este aproape să sosească şi zilele ei nu vor zăbovi!
translations.grk: καὶ ὀνοκένταυροι ἐκεῖ κατοικήσουσι, καὶ νοσσοποιήσουσιν ἐχῖνοι ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις αὐτῶν. Ταχὺ ἔρχεται καὶ οὐ χρονιεῖ.
